description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm and a Map token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Map, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm and two Map tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing the Maps and a Worldwalker Helm, adding six {C}.
Repeat from step 3.
